thread:
Alex R.: quick sync — throughput/latency sprint status. where are we on kernel changes, continuous batching rollout, and KV cache prefetch? owners / blockers / timeline?
Mei Chen: kernel PR #832 is awaiting final perf numbers, left a comment about attention kernel ordering. seeing ~6% regression for sequences >2k on p99 in my local runs.
Jamal Ortiz: KV prefetch branch is feature-complete, experiments show ~9% token-cost reduction. need Mei to re-run with kernel branch to validate interaction. pinging @Mei Chen for review.
Priyanka Nair: continuous batching infra is staged. perf tests show p95 down 12% under steady QPS, but median tail rises during burst mode — might be a scheduling knob. will add instrumented traces tomorrow.
Luis G.: fyi I hit a flaky e2e around reroute-on-fallback, filing ticket: https://rwd.internal/issue/INF-1198. suggests we tighten canary windows before wide rollout.
Tara K.: suggested canary plan: 10% traffic -> 30m monitor -> 50% -> 2h -> 100%. sample config below:
```yaml
canary:
  init_traffic: 0.1
  stages:
    - duration: 30m
      traffic: 0.3
    - duration: 2h
      traffic: 0.5
rollback_on:
  - p99_latency > 2s
  - error_rate > 0.5%
```
Alex R.: who owns the rollback/fallback policy integration? we should ensure automatic fallback to smaller model variant if p99 crosses threshold. @Oncall SRE?
Oncall SRE: yesterday at 03:14 we saw a degrade alert during a burst, logs show OOM on worker-13 and rapid reconnects. excerpt:
```
[03:14:22] worker-13 OutOfMemoryError: failed to allocate 1.2GB KV cache
[03:14:23] worker-13 connection dropped to router-2, reconnecting...
```
Recommend temporary throttle on long-seq requests while we patch.
BuildBot: CI: jamal/kv-prefetch -> checks: unit ✅ integration ✅ flake8 ❌ (style failures). rerun once fixed. :robot_face:
Mei Chen: thanks, will repro the p99 regression with the kernel commit and post numbers. will also review Jamal's PR after flake fix.
Priyanka Nair: can someone update the perf dataset to include larger-context prompts? add "sprint-batching-1" to the eval harness. I can run the baseline once dataset is in.
Alex R.: action items: (1) @Mei Chen repro kernel perf and post numbers (due EOD Thu), (2) @Jamal fix flake + request review (today), (3) @Priyanka add dataset + run baseline (Fri), (4) @Tara run canary using config once CI green, (5) @Oncall SRE prepare throttle plan for long-seq traffic. I'll follow up in Friday standup. cheers :thumbsup:
